champions.gameplayImpact: Sion loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: No longer becomes unable to attack for 0.25 seconds shortly after entering champion combat.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: No longer prevents Soul Furnace}} and its Soul Furnace 2|recast}} from being cast for a brief moment after releasing the charge.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: No longer locks Sion out of attacking, moving and casting movement spells for up-to 0.25 seconds after the missile is fired.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: This fixes several bugs where non-crowd control effects that prevent Sion from attacking or moving (e.g. Decimating Smash}}, ) were having those disables ignored for 0.25 seconds after the disable from Roar of the Slayer wore off.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Moving during Decimating Smash}} for this reason cancelled the channel.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Stun duration is no longer 0.75–1.75 (lv 0–3) seconds instead of the normal 0.25–1.75 (lv 0–3) when colliding with Unstoppable Onslaught 2|the recast leap}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed an oversight where the server would still accept attack move commands to alter Sion's otherwise-restricted movement.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: This fixes an exploit where cheaters could deliberately input these orders through their means to fully control Sion's movement.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Delayed attack move packets can thus also no longer change Sion's movement during Unstoppable Onslaught a single time.
